evidence_locations: Definition 2.3 of fiber space, p.8

independent_verification.assumptions: Take W=P^2, W'=Bl_p P^2, beta_W=b the blowdown, V'=V=W' x P^1, beta_V=id, f'=projection and f=b composed with projection, Delta'=0. All spaces are smooth normal projective, both beta maps are projective birational, and both vertical maps are proper surjective with connected fibers as expressly defined. No equidimensionality occurs in the lemma's hypotheses. f' is a product, hence locally constant with simply connected fiber P^1. W and (V',0) are klt and -(K_V'/W')=2 pr_P1^*O(1) is nef.
independent_verification.independent_proof: For q not p the f-fiber is P^1 (dimension one); at p it is E x P^1=P^1 x P^1 (dimension two). An analytic local product has constant fiber dimension, so f is not locally trivial. On an affine blow-up chart (u,v,w)->(u,uv), the special fiber ideal is (u,uv)=(u), while at (1,0), (u-1,uv)=(u-1,v) because v=uv-v(u-1). These quotient rings have dimensions two and one. The global blow-up/product, not just the chart, provides properness and connectedness. For C1=E x {z0}, beta_V is the identity and f'(C1)=E, disproving the asserted contraction. With H=b^*O(1), H^2=1,H.E=0,E^2=-1, so (2H-E).E=1 and (2H-E)^2=3. For any other irreducible strict-transform curve dH-mE, 0<=m<=d and (2H-E).C=2d-m>0, confirming ampleness by the surface criterion. The product ample A has beta_V^*A.C1=1, contradicting the printed zero.
independent_verification.counterevidence: The main theorem asserts existence of an MRC structure after a cover, while this example refutes the assertion about an arbitrary specified diagram. The actual applications have additional geometric facts including equidimensionality; those do not make the stated general lemma true.
independent_verification.impact: The false auxiliary assertion is invoked explicitly at the principal descent steps on pp.36 and 37. This is a demonstrated core proof-chain defect, not merely an unproved suspicion.
independent_verification.repair: A narrower descent theorem must be proved using the actual extra geometry, with the contraction/factorization and pair/boundary conditions checked in both applications.
independent_verification.repair_limits: No complete such replacement is established here. Adding equidimensionality alone is not asserted to be sufficient; the original invalid curve inference cannot simply be reused.

independent_verification.assumptions: Let C be a smooth plane quartic, V=C x P^1, W=C, h=projection,D=0. This is a locally constant smooth projective product with fiber irregularity zero and nef negative relative canonical divisor. Choose the ample B=h^*O_C(1)+pr_P1^*O(1), with B0=pr_P1^*O(1), BW=O_C(1) as permitted by Lemma 2.4. Then E_m=O_C^(m+1), so even unitary trivial flatness holds. A=O_C(1) is very ample, exactly meeting the written choice.
independent_verification.independent_proof: Adjunction gives K_C=(K_P2+C)|C=O_C(1), with deg K_C=4 and genus three. Since C is smooth connected projective, Serre duality gives h^1(K_C)=h^0(O_C)=1. Taking d=i=1 gives E_m tensor O((d+1-i)A)=K_C^(direct sum m+1) and h^1=m+1>0. This refutes the displayed inference even with a positive twist of a trivial bundle; it does not refute the conclusion that B0 is nef.
independent_verification.counterevidence: The preceding proof already gives numerical flatness of E_m. A stronger, still single fixed choice of auxiliary A can repair the inference; the chosen main-theorem bases may also have extra canonical geometry. These facts do not validate the general displayed vanishing for the allowed quartic choice.
independent_verification.impact: The inference supplies uniform regularity/global generation and nefness of B0, which feeds Lemma 4.5 and Theorem 4.12. Its proximity to the main proof supports Major independently of the existence of a short local repair.
independent_verification.repair: After the source's smooth-base reduction, choose one very ample A with A-K_W ample. For 1<=i<=d, L_i=(d+1-i)A-K_W=(A-K_W)+(d-i)A is ample. Use the numerical-flat filtration by unitary flat quotients Q: Kodaira-Nakano gives H^i(K_W tensor Q tensor L_i)=0, and finite long exact sequences give the same for E_m. The same A works for every m. For the closing relative basepoint-free step retain the klt pair (V,D) and -(K_V/W+D), use relatively nef and big B0 and sufficiently divisible multiples; do not assert -K_V/W nef from the log hypothesis.
independent_verification.repair_limits: This establishes the local correction conditional on the previously established numerical flatness and its standard filtration/vanishing inputs. It supplies no repair of the false Lemma 4.5 and no whole-paper certificate.

independent_verification.assumptions: Identity morphism of a smooth analytic disk; E is the trivial line bundle with trivial metric, theta=0, locally free everywhere, reflexive dual pullback, empty bad locus. Use two summands with s1=s2=f1=f2=1; no orthogonality or basis condition is required in the source.
independent_verification.independent_proof: The displayed inequality specializes to |1+1|^2<=1+1, or 4<=2. Triangle inequality followed by scalar Cauchy-Schwarz instead gives |sum_i f_i s_i|^2 <= (sum_i |f_i||s_i|)^2 <= m sum_i |f_i|^2 |s_i|^2.
independent_verification.counterevidence: The intended bound is local and the expansion is finite. Multiplication by m does not affect upper boundedness or the plurisubharmonic extension argument.
independent_verification.impact: Minor coefficient error, with no demonstrated failure of Lemma 2.8's conclusion.
independent_verification.repair: Insert m on the RHS or use the product of the sums of squared norms, using a sufficiently small local neighborhood for the expansion.
independent_verification.repair_limits: This does not validate a global tensor-section identity on arbitrary analytic open sets; the local-generation implementation suffices.
